original.target_description: Auxiliary be; original COREFL L1-Spanish/L2-English study; pooled A1/A2 beginners versus pooled B1/B2 intermediates; raw-frequency TLU/non-TLU chi-square contrast.

n.sample_role: Morpheme-specific raw-frequency annotation/context observations in the 2×2 target-like-use versus non-target-like-use contrast: beginners (A1+A2) versus intermediates (B1+B2). Not learner participants or text count.
n.exclusions: Auxiliary be in progressive and passive contexts. No additional model-specific exclusions stated for these printed contrast totals. Participant contribution counts per morpheme are not established.
n.location: Accepted manuscript p.19, section 4.1 (group definition); p.19, section 4.1 footnote 8
n.quote:
By conflating A1 and A2 together into
‘beginners’ and B1 and B2 into ‘intermediates’ (Figure 6B),7 beginners significantly
differ from intermediates for each morpheme (p<0.02 for all χ2 contrasts),8 except for ... auxiliary be (TLU=20/40 vs. 46/48, χ2=24.444)
